n = int(input())
k = int(input())
p = int(input())

def bin_pow(a, b, p):
    if b == 0:
        return 1
    x = bin_pow(a, b // 2, p)
    x = (x * x) % p
    if b & 1:
        x = (x * a) % p
    return x

MAXN = 250250
fact = [1] * (MAXN + 1)
rfact = [1] * (MAXN + 1)
g = [[0] * 17 for _ in range(MAXN + 1)]
cnt = 0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % p
    rfact[i] = bin_pow(fact[i], p - 2, p)

if n & 1:
    print(bin_pow(k, n, p))
    exit()

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if (i & n) != i:
        continue
    bit = []
    for j in range(18):
        if (1 << j) & i:
            bit.append(j)
    def solve(n, bit, k, l):
        nonlocal cnt
        if k == len(bit):
            cnt += 1
            for i in range(1, 17):
                g[n][i] = (g[n][i] + rfact[l] * g[n ^ l][i - 1]) % p
            if cnt >= 8:
                cnt = 0
            return
        solve(n, bit, k + 1, l)
        solve(n, bit, k + 1, l ^ (1 << bit[k]))
    solve(i, bit, 1, 1 << bit[0])

ans = 0
for i in range(1, min(17, k + 1)):
    g[n][i] %= p
    cur = fact[n] * g[n][i] % p
    cur = (cur * fact[k]) % p
    cur = (cur * rfact[k - i]) % p
    ans = (ans + cur) % p

ans = (bin_pow(k, n, p) - ans) % p
print(ans)
